List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the August 26, 2004/Bhadrapada 4, 1926 (Saka)

 External Affairs; Labour and Employment; Non-Resident Indians

 Pensions; Planning; Road Transport and Highways; Science and

 and Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions — 20
Social Security Schemes under EPFO
*441. SHRI DIPANKAR MUKHERJEE:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had designated
the Employees Provident Fund
Organisation (EPFO) as the nodal agency
for administering social security schemes
in the country; and
(b) whether the EPFO, as a nodal
agency, has been authorised to issue
National Social Security Numbers to the
workers covered under various social
security schemes?
Services for accident victims on
Highways
*442. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the NHAI
Project Office in Rajahmundry has
received offers of help from NGOs and
others to attend on accident victims and
also provide First Aid, etc. on major
Highways like NH-5;
(b) if so, the details thereof and whether
any action has been initiated in this matter;
(c) whether it is a fact that the NHAI
has not reacted to such offers; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor and the
steps proposed to be taken to immediately
attend to such offers?
Labour laws on LPG distributors
†*443. SHRI RAM NATH KOVIND:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Labour laws like State
Insurance Corporation and Provident Fund
laws have been enforced on LPG
distributors; and
(b) the grounds on which these labour
laws have been enforced?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

134
Express lane on NH-9
*444. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether representation has been
received to take up expeditious completion
of the four lane express way on NH-9 from
Hyderabad to Vijayawada which is vital
from business and commercial point of view;
and
(b) if so, the action proposed to
complete the project early to avoid 30 to
40 accidents taking place daily due to heavy
traffic?
Civil Services Reforms
*445. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Committee on Civil
Services Reforms headed by Shri P.C. Hota
has submitted its report to the Union
Cabinet Secretary on the 30th July, 2004;
(b) if so, the salient features of the
recommendations made by the Committee
in its report; and
(c) the reaction of Government thereto?
Death of lab animals at ITRC,
Lucknow
*446. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether due to failure of air
conditioning system in June last about 700
lab animals died in the newly constructed
modern laboratory of Industrial and
Toxicology Research Centre of CSIR at
Lucknow;
(b) if so, whether the cause of the
failure of the air-conditioning system has
been investigated, if so, the details
thereof;
(c) the extent of financial loss caused to
the research centre due to the incident; and
(d) the action taken to prevent such
incidents and also against those found
negligent in the discharge of their duty in
this incident?
Release of Indian hostages/captives in
Iraq
†*447. SHRI PYARELAL KHAN-
DELWAL: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a state of
confusion prevailed regarding release of
Indian hostages in Iraq only due to the
evasive policy of Government;
(b) whether it is also a fact that a large
number of Indian Nationals are still
working in American Military camps as
captives;
(c) if so, the details thereof and by when
Government would bring them back to
India;
(d) whether Indian Embassy in Iraq
remained a silent spectator in this case; and
(e) if not, the details of action taken by
it?
Indians in foreign jails
† *448. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Indians lodged in
foreign jails, country-wise;
(b) whether any steps are being taken
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(c) if so, the details thereof?

Employment generation through
rural industrialisation
†2383. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
boost up rural industrialisation with the
help of private and public sectors for
uplifting the rural standard of living and
generating more opportunities of
employment by establishing better co-
ordination between towns and villages;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when the final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken?
Labour migration
2384. SHRIMATI MOHSINA KIDWAI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that due to inadequate agro-based
industries a large scale of labour migration
is occurring in Chhattisgarh to other States
leading to their exploitation in those States;
(b) whether Government propose to
establish some agro-based industries to
arrest large scale of labour migration; and
(c) if so, the number and details of the
industries that are proposed or have been
established so far in the State?
KVIC units in Uttaranchal
†2385. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the units set up in
Uttaranchal by the Khadi and Village
Industries Commission  (KVIC) during the
last three years, year-wise;
(b) whether some of the units already
set up by the KVIC in this State have been
closed;
(c) if so, the total number of the units
closed;
(d) whether Government have fixed any

target to open new units in the State during
the current plan period; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Financial conditions of farmers
†2386. SHRI VEDPRAKASH P.
GOYAL: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any plan to establish agriculture
based industries to provide technical
training for it as well as to provide financial
assistance for the establishment of
industries to farmers in order to bring
improvement in the economic conditions
of the farmers;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, whether Government are
considering to formulate any plan in this
regard, in the near future?
Revolving funds for training rural
youth in Karnataka
2387. SHRI K. B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Karnataka has sought Central assistance
for starting a revolving fund for training
rural youth in job-oriented courses;
(b) if so, the amount of Central
assistance sought; and
(c) the present status of the proposal?
Crisis in the Coir Industry
2388. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government  are aware of
the fact that the Coir Industry is facing
serious crisis;
(b) whether Government have
contemplated any comprehensive plan to
tide over the crisis;
(c) whether Government have taken
initiative to put coir as an agricultural
product in the WTO list; and
(d) if so, the details and the results of
such initiatives?
Duties of Coir Board in Andhra
Pradesh
2389. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have assigned
specific duties to the Coir Board to help
coconut growers;
(b) to what extent the Coir Board has
made its presence felt in Andhra Pradesh;
(c) the details of such work done by the
Coir Board in helping farmers of Andhra
Pradesh in the year 2003-04;
(d) whether any funds were made
available by the Coir Board in that period;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Exploration of Mineral Sand in
Kerala
2390. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the stage at which the joint venture
project participating NMDP, IRE and
KSIDC for the exploration of mineral sand
of chavara in Kerala stands at present; and
(b) the progress attained in the proposal
so far?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
